decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's agency and compliance focus, has positive customer feedback on its nearly 200 templates, and costs little to keep running.
The management platform is the flagship shown on the home page and is central to the firm's agency-focused strategy, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business and supports scalable offers for agencies, so it is likely to stay, though it could be renamed or folded into other plans.
